It bounced back with a clarifying question before beginning, which really impressed me. I’ve never experienced that level of intuitiveness in an AI tool.

I told the AI: “Please use this photo and redesign it in a French country style. Rustic wood beams would be great, as well as warm colours. Make it an inviting space that’s completely furnished. Keep the same layout.”

I’m always looking for the fastest, easiest way to present a compelling, realistic visual to a client. But, it can’t look too AI-generated. You know what I mean. Some AI designs just scream “robot-made,” and I’d never show that to a client.
